1.1: Mavoy shehu gavoah lemala meesrim amma, yemaet. rabbi yehuda omer, eno tzarich. veharachav meeser ammot, yemaet. veim yesh lo tzurat happetach, af al pi shehu rachav meeser ammot, en tzarich lemaet:
1.2: Hechsher mavoy, bet shammay omrim, lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim, lechi o kora. rabbi eliezer omer, lechayayin. mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad lifne rabbi akiva, lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al mavoy shehu fachot mearba ammot, shehu o velechi o vekora. al ma nechleku, al rachav mearba ammot vead eser, shebbet shammay omrim, lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim, o lechi o kora. amar rabbi akiva, al ze veal ze nechelaku:
1.3: Hakkora sheamru, rechava kede lekabbel ariach. veariach, chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim. dayya lakkora shettehe rechava tefach, kede lekabbel ariach learko:
1.4: Rechava, kede lekabbel ariach, uveria, kede lekabbel ariach. rabbi yehuda omer, rechava af al pi sheen beria:
1.5: Hayta shel kash o shel kanim, roin otah keillu hi shel mattechet. akumma, roin otah keillu hi feshuta. agulla, roin otah keillu hi merubbaat. kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim, yesh bo rochav tafach:
1.6: Lechayayin sheamru, gavhan asara tefachim, verachban veavyan kol shehu. rabbi yose omer, rachban shelosha tefachim:
1.7: Bakkol osin lechayayin, afillu vedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim. verabbi yose oser. umetamme mishshum golel, verabbi meir metaher. vechotvin alav gitte nashim, verabbi yose haggelili fosel:
1.8: Shayyara shechanta bevika vehikkifuha vichle vehema, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe gader gavoah asara tefachim, velo yihyu feratzot yeterot al habbinyan. kol pirtza shehi cheeser ammot, mutteret, mippene shehi chefetach. yater mikkan, asur:
1.9: Makkifin shelosha chavalim, ze lemala mizze veze lemala mizze, uvilvad shello yehe ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim. shiur chavalim veavyan, yater al tefach, kede sheyyehe hakkol asara tefachim:
1.10: Makkifin bekanim, uvilvad shello yehe ven kane lachavero shelosha tefachim. beshayyara dibberu, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, lo dibberu veshayyara ella vahove. kol mechitztza sheenah shel sheti veshel erev, enah mechitztza, divre rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, echad mishshene devarim. arbaa devarim patru vammachane, meviin etzim mikkol makom, ufeturim merchitzat yadayim, umiddemay, umillearev:

2.1: Osin passin labberaot arbaa deyumedin, nirin kishmona, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, shemona, nirin kishnem asar, arbaa deyumedin vearbaa feshutin. gavhan asara tefachim, verachban shishsha, veavyan kol shehu, uvenehen kimlo shete revakot shel shalosh shalosh bakar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shel arba arba, keshurot velo muttarot, achat nichneset veachat yotzet:
2.2: Muttar lehakeriv labbeer, uvilvad shettehe fara roshah verubbah bifnim veshota. muttar leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin:
2.3: Rabbi yehuda omer, ad bet satayim. amru lo, lo amru vet satayim ella leginna ulekarpef, aval im haya dir o sachar, o muktze o chatzer, afillu vet chameshet korin, afillu vet asara korin, muttar. umuttar leharechik kol shehu, uvilvad sheyyarbe befassin:
2.4: Rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta derech harabbim mafsaktan, yesallekenna latztzedadin. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich. echad bor harabbim, uveer harabbim, uveer hayyachid, osin lahen passin, aval levor hayyachid osin lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda ven bava omer, en osin passin ella liver harabbim bilvad, velashshear osin chagora gavoah asara tefachim:
2.5: Veod amar rabbi yehuda ven bava, hagginna vehakkarpef shehen shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim, mukkefet gader gavoah asara tefachim, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe vah shomera o vet dira, o shettehe semucha lair. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu en bah ella vor veshiach umeara, metaltelin betochah. rabbi akiva omer, afillu en bah achat mikkol ellu, metaltelin betochah, uvilvad sheyyehe vah shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim. rabbi eliezer omer, im haya arkah yater al rachbah afillu amma achat, en metaltelin betochah. rabbi yose omer, afillu arkah pi shenayim berachbah, metaltelin betochah:
2.6: Amar rabbi illaiy, shamati merabbi eliezer, vaafillu hi kevet kor. vechen shamati mimmennu, anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehen velo erev, beto asur millehachnis ulehotzi, lo, aval lahem muttar. vechen shamati mimmennu, sheyyotzin beakravnim befesach. vechizzarti al kol talmidav uvikkashti li chaver, velo matzati:

3.1: Bakkol mearvin umishtattefim, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. vehakkol nikkach bechesef maaser, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach. hannoder min hammazon, muttar bemayim uvemelach. mearvin lenazir beyayin uleyisrael bitruma. sumechos omer, bechullin. ulechohen bevet happeras. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu bevet hakkevarot, mippene sheyyachol lelech lachotz veleechol:
3.2: Mearvin bidmay, uvemaaser rishon shenittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. vehakkohanim, bechalla uvitruma. aval lo vetevel, velo vemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo vemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. hashsholeach eruvo beyad cheresh, shote vekatan, o veyad mi sheeno mode vaeruv, eno eruv. veim amar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu, hare ze eruv:
3.3: Netano veilan, lemala measara tefachim, en eruvo eruv. lematta measara tefachim, eruvo eruv. netano bevor, afillu amok mea amma, eruvo eruv. netano verosh hakkane o verosh hakkundas bizman shehu talush venautz, afillu gavoah mea amma, hare ze eruv. netano vemigdal veavad hammafteach, hare ze eruv. rabbi eliezer omer, im eno yodea shehammafteach bimkomo, eno eruv:
3.4: Nitgalgel chutz lattechum, venafal alav gal, o nisraf, o teruma venitmet, mibbeod yom, eno eruv, mishshechashecha, hare ze eruv. im safek, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda omrim, hare ze chammar gammal. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, sefek eruv, kasher. amar rabbi yose, avtolmos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim al sefek eruv shekkasher:
3.5: Matne adam al eruvo veomer, im bau goyim min hammizrach, eruvi lammaarav. min hammaarav, eruvi lammizrach. im bau mikkan umikkan, limkom sheertze elech. lo vau lo mikkan velo mikkan, hareni chivne iri. im ba chacham min hammizrach, eruvi lammizrach. min hammaarav, eruvi lammaarav. ba lechan ulechan, limkom sheertze elech. lo lechan velo lechan, hareni chivne iri. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya echad mehen rabbo, holech etzel rabbo, veim hayu shenehem rabbotav, limkom sheyyirtze yelech:
3.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, yom tov hassamuch leshabbat, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha, mearev adam shene eruvin veomer, eruvi harishon lammizrach, vehashsheni lammaarav. harishon lammaarav, vehashsheni lammizrach. eruvi harishon, vehashsheni kivne iri. eruvi hashsheni, veharishon kivne iri. vachachamim omrim, mearev leruach achat, o eno mearev kol ikkar. o mearev lishne yamim, o eno mearev kol ikkar. ketzad yaase. molicho varishon, umachshich alav venotlo uva lo. bashsheni machshich alav veochlo. venimtza mistakker bahalichato umistakker beeruvo. neechal barishon, eruvo larishon veeno eruv lashsheni. amar lahem rabbi eliezer, modim attem li shehen shete kedushshot:
3.7: Rabbi yehuda omer, rosh hashshana, shehaya yare shemma titabber, mearev adam shene eruvin veomer, eruvi varishon lammizrach uvashsheni lammaarav, barishon lammaarav uvashsheni lammizrach. eruvi barishon, uvashsheni kivne iri. eruvi bashsheni, uvarishon kivne iri. velo hodu lo chachamim:
3.8: Veod amar rabbi yehuda, matne adam al hakkalkala beyom tov rishon veochlah bashsheni. vechen betza shennolda varishon, teachel bashsheni. velo hodu lo chachamim:
3.9: Rabbi dosa ven harekinas omer, haover lifne hatteva beyom tov shel rosh hashshana omer, hachalitzenu Adonai elohenu et yom rosh chodesh hazze, im hayyom, im lemachar. ulemachar hu omer, im hayyom, im emesh. velo hodu lo chachamim:

4.1: Mi shehotziuhu goyim o ruach raa, en lo ella arba ammot. hecheziruhu, keillu lo yatza. holichuhu leir acheret. netanuhu vedir o vesahar, rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya omrim, mehallech et kullah. rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva omrim, en lo ella arba ammot. maase shebbau mipperandisin vehifliga sefinatam bayyam. rabban gamliel verabbi elazar ben azarya hillechu et kullah. rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva lo zazu mearba ammot, sheratzu lehachamir al atzman:
4.2: Paam achat lo nichnesu lannamal ad shechashecha. amru lo lerabban gamliel, ma anu lered. amar lahen, muttar attem, shekkevar hayiti mistakkel, vehayinu vetoch hattechum ad shello chashecha:
4.3: Mi sheyyatza virshut veamru lo, kevar naasa maase, yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach. im haya vetoch hattechum, keillu lo yatza, shekkol hayyotzim lehatztzil, chozrin limkoman:
4.4: Mi sheyyashav badderech, veamad, veraa vahare hu samuch lair, hoil velo hayta chavvanato lechach, lo yikkanes, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, yikkanes. amar rabbi yehuda, maase haya, venichnas rabbi tarfon belo mitkavven:
4.5: Mi sheyyashen badderech velo yada shechashecha, yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri. vachachamim omrim, en lo ella arba ammot. rabbi eliezer omer, vehu veemtzaan. rabbi yehuda omer, leeze ruach sheyyirtze yelech. umode rabbi yehuda sheim berer lo, sheeno yachol lachazor bo:
4.6: Hayu shenayim, miktzat ammotav shel ze betoch ammotav shel ze, meviin veochlin baemtza, uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero. hayu shelosha, vehaemtzai muvla benehen, hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo, ushenayim hachitzonim asurim ze im ze. amar rabbi shimon, lema haddavar dome, leshalosh chatzerot happetuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lirshut harabbim, ervu shetehen im haemtzait, hi mutteret immahem vehen muttarot immah, ushetayim hachitzonot asurot zo im zo:
4.7: Mi shebba vadderech vechashcha lo, vehaya makkir ilan o gader, veamar, shevitati tachtav, lo amar kelum. shevitati veikkaro, mehallech mimmekom raglav vead ikkaro alpayim amma, umeikkaro vead beto alpayim amma. nimtza mehallech mishshechashecha arbaat alafim amma:
4.8: Im eno makkir, o sheeno vaki vahalacha, veamar, shevitati vimkomi, zacha lo mekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach. agullot, divre rabbi chanina ven antignos. vachachamim omrim, merubbaot, ketavla merubbaat, kede sheyyehe niskar lazzaviyyot:
4.9: Vezo hi sheamru, heani mearev beraglav. amar rabbi meir, anu en lanu ella ani. rabbi yehuda omer, echad ani veechad ashir, lo amru mearvin befat ella lehakel al heashir, shello yetze viarev beraglav:
4.10: Mi sheyyatza lelech beir shemmearvin bah vehecheziro chavero, hu muttar lelech vechol bene hair asurin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kol shehu yachol learev velo erev, hare ze chammar gammal:
4.11: Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, lo yikkanes. rabbi eliezer omer, shetayim, yikkanes, shalosh, lo yikkanes. mi shehechshich chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, lo yikkanes. rabbi shimon omer, afillu chamesh esre ammot, yikkanes, sheen hammashochot mematztzin et hammiddot, mippene hattoin:

5.1: Ketzad meabberin et hearim, bayit nichnas bayit yotze, pagum nichnas pagum yotze. hayu sham gedudiyyot gevohot asara tefachim, ugesharim unefashot, sheyyesh bahen bet dira, motziin et hammidda chenegdan, veosin otah kemin tavla merubbaat, kede sheyyehe niskar et hazzaviyyot:
5.2: Notnin karpef lair, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, lo amru karpef ella ven shete ayarot, im yesh lazo shivim amma veshirayim, velazo shivim amma veshirayim, ose karpef lishtehen lihyotan keechat:
5.3: Vechen shelosha chefarim hammeshullashin, im yesh ben shenayim hachitzonim mea vearbaim veechad ushelish, asa emtzai et shelashtan lihyotan keechad:
5.4: En moddin ella vechevel shel chamishshim amma, lo fachot velo yoter. velo yimdod ella cheneged libbo. haya moded vehiggia legay o legader, mavlio vechozer lemiddato. higgia lehar, mavlio vechozer lemiddato, uvilvad shello yetze chutz lattechum. im eno yachol lehavelio, bazo amar rabbi dostay bar rabbi yannay mishshum rabbi meir, shamati shemmekadderin beharim:
5.5: En moddin ella min hammumche. ribba lemakom echad umiet lemakom acher, shomin limkom sheribba. ribba leechad umiet leacher, shomin lamrubbe. afillu eved, afillu shifcha, neemanin lomar, ad kan techum shabbat, shello amru chachamim et haddavar lehachamir ella lehakel:
5.6: Ir shel yachid venaaset shel rabbim, mearvin et kullah. veshel rabbim venaaset shel yachid, en mearvin et kullah, ella im ken asa chutza lah keir chadasha shebbihuda, sheyyesh bah chamishshim diurim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, shalosh chatzerot shel shene vattim:
5.7: Mi shehaya vammizrach veamar livno, arev li vammaarav, bammaarav veamar livno, arev li vammizrach, im yesh hemennu uleveto alpayim ammot, uleeruvo yoter mikkan, muttar leveto veasur leeruvo. leeruvo alpayim amma, uleveto yoter mikkan, asur leveto umuttar leeruvo. hannoten et eruvo veibburah shel ir, lo asa velo chelum. netano chutz lattechum, afillu amma achat, ma shenniskar hu mafsid:
5.8: Anshe ir gedola mehallechin et kol ir ketanna, veen anshe ir ketanna mehallechin et kol ir gedola. ketzad. mi shehaya veir gedola venatan et eruvo veir ketanna, beir ketanna venatan et eruvo veir gedola, mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. verabbi akiva omer, en lo ella mimmekom eruvo alpayim amma:
5.9: Amar lahen rabbi akiva, i attem modim li venoten eruvo vimara, sheen lo mimmekom eruvo ella alpayim amma. amru lo, ematay, bizman sheen bah diurin, aval yesh bah diurin, mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. nimtza, kal tochah meal gabbah. velammoded sheamru notnin lo alpayim, sheafillu sof middato kale vimara:

6.1: Haddar im hannachri vechatzer, o im mi sheeno mode vaeruv, hare ze oser alav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, leolam eno oser ad sheyyehu shene yisreelim osrin ze al ze:
6.2: Amar rabban gamliel, maase vitzdoki echad, shehaya dar immanu bemavoy birushalayim, veamar lanu abba, maharu vehotziu et kol hakkelim lammavoy, ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem. rabbi yehuda omer belashon acher, maharu vaasu tzarchechem bammavoy ad shello yotzi veyeesor alechem:
6.3: Anshe chatzer sheshshachach achad mehen velo erev, beto asur millehachnis umillehotzi, lo velahem, veshellahem muttarin, lo velahem. natnu lo reshutan, hu muttar vehen asurin. hayu shenayim, osrin ze al ze, sheechad noten reshut venotel reshut, shenayim notnim reshut veen notlin reshut:
6.4: Meematay notnin reshut. bet shammay omrim, mibbeod yom, uvet hillel omrim, mishshechashecha. mi shennatan reshuto vehotzi, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, bemezid oser, beshogeg eno oser:
6.5: Baal habbayit shehaya shuttaf lishchenim, laze veyayin velaze veyayin, enam tzerichim learev. laze veyayin velaze veshemen, tzerichim learev. rabbi shimon omer, echad ze veechad ze, enam tzerichim learev:
6.6: Chamesh chavurot sheshshavtu vitraklin echad, bet shammay omrim, eruv lechol chavura vachavura. uvet hillel omrim, eruv echad lechullan. umodim, bizman shemmiktzatan sheruyin bachadarim o vaaliyyot, shehen tzerichin eruv lechol chavura vachavura:
6.7: Haachin hashshuttafin shehayu ochlin al shulchan avihem vishenim bevattehem, tzerichin eruv lechol echad veechad. lefichach, im shachach echad mehem velo erev, mevattel et reshuto. ematay, bizman shemmolichin eruvan bemakom acher, aval im haya eruv ba etzlan, o sheen immahen diurin bechatzer, enan tzerichin learev:
6.8: Chamesh chatzerot petuchot zo lazo ufetuchot lemavoy, ervu vachatzerot velo nishtattefu vammavoy, muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy. veim nishtattefu vammavoy, muttarin kan vachan. ervu vachatzerot venishtattefu vammavoy, veshachach echad mibbene chatzer velo erev, muttarin kan vachan. mibbene mavoy velo nishtattef, muttarin bachatzerot vaasurin bammavoy, shehammavoy lachatzerot kechatzer labbattim:
6.9: Shete chatzerot, zo lifnim mizzo, erva happenimit velo erva hachitzona, happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. hachitzona, velo happenimit, shetehen asurot. erva zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah, zo mutteret bifne atzmah vezo mutteret bifne atzmah. rabbi akiva oser hachitzona, shedderisat haregel osartah. vachachamim omrim, en derisat haregel osartah:
6.10: Shachach achad min hachitzona velo erev, happenimit mutteret vehachitzona asura. min happenimit velo erev, shetehen asurot. natnu eruvan bemakom echad, veshachach echad, ben min happenimit ben min hachitzona, velo erev, shetehen asurot. veim hayu shel yechidim, enan tzerichin learev:

7.1: Challon shebben shete chatzerot, arbaa al arbaa, betoch asara, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu, mearvin echad. pachot mearbaa al arbaa, o lemala measara, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad:
7.2: Kotel shebben shete chatzerot gavoah asara verachav arbaa, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad. hayu verosho ferot, ellu olin mikkan veochlin, veellu olin mikkan veochlin, uvilvad shello yoridu lematta. nifretza hakkotel ad eser ammot, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu mearvin echad, mippene shehu chefetach. yoter mikkan, mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim:
7.3: Charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara verachav arba, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad, afillu male kash o teven. male afar, o tzerorot, mearvin echad, veen mearvin shenayim:
7.4: Natan alav neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim, vechen shete gezuzteraot zo cheneged zo, mearvin shenayim, veim ratzu, mearvin echad. pachot mikkan, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad:
7.5: Matben shebben shete chatzerot, gavoah asara tefachim, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad. ellu maachilin mikkan veellu maachilin mikkan. nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim, mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim:
7.6: Ketzad mishtattefin bammavoy. meniach et hechavit veomer, hare zo lechol bene mavoy, umezakke lahen al yede veno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yede ishto, aval eno mezakke lo al yede veno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado:
7.7: Nitmaet haochel, mosif umezakke, veen tzarich lehodia. nittosfu alehem, mosif umezakke, vetzarich lehodia:
7.8: Kamma hu shiuro. bizman shehen merubbin, mezon shete seudot lechullam. bizman shehen muatin, kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat lechol echad veechad:
7.9: Amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bitchillat eruv. aval bishyare eruv, kol shehu. velo amru learev bachatzerot ella chede shello leshakkeach et hattinokot:
7.10: Bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, kikkar hu eruv. afillu maafe sea vehi ferusa, en mearvin bah. kikkar beissar vehu shalem, mearvin bo:
7.11: Noten adam maa lechenvani ulenachtom kede sheyyizke lo eruv, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, lo zachu lo meotav. umodim bishar kol adam shezzachu lo meotav, sheen mearvin leadam ella middato. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, beeruve techumin, aval beeruve chatzerot, mearvin ledato veshello ledato, lefi shezzachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin leadam shello befanav:

8.1: Ketzad mishtattefin battechumin. meniach et hechavit veomer, hare ze lechol bene iri, lechol mi sheyyelech levet haevel o levet hammishte. vechol shekkibbel alav mibbeod yom, muttar. mishshettechshach, asur, sheen mearvin mishshettechshach:
8.2: Kamma hu shiuro, mezon shete seudot lechol echad. mezono lechol velo leshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, leshabbat velo lechol. veze vaze mitkavvenin lehakel. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, mikkikkar befundeyon, mearba sein besela. rabbi shimon omer, shete yadot lechikkar mishshalosh lekav. chetzyah levayit hamenugga, vachatzi chetzyah lifsol et haggeviyya:
8.3: Anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu, kol sheggavoah asara tefachim, lammirpeset. pachot mikkan, lechatzer. chulyat habbor vehassela, gevohim asara tefachim, lammirpeset. pachot mikkan, lechatzer. bamme devarim amurim, bismucha. aval bemufleget, afillu gavoah asara tefachim, lechatzer. veezo hi semucha, kol sheenah rechoka arbaa tefachim:
8.4: Hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar, achsadra umirpeset, eno eruv. vehaddar sham, eno oser alav. bevet hatteven uvevet habbakar uvevet haetzim uvevet haotzarot, hare ze eruv. vehaddar sham, oser alav. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh sham tefisat yad shel baal habbayit, eno oser alav:
8.5: Hammanniach beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret, echad nachri veechad yisrael, hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, eno oser. rabbi yose omer, nachri oser, yisrael eno oser, sheen derech yisrael lavo veshabbat. rabbi shimon omer, afillu hinniach beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto veotah hair, eno oser, shekkevar hissia millibbo:
8.6: Bor shebben shete chatzerot, en memallein mimmennu veshabbat, ella im ken asu lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim ben milmala, ben millematta, ben mittoch ogno. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bet shammay omrim, millematta. uvet hillel omrim, milmala. amar rabbi yehuda, lo tehe mechitztza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehem:
8.7: Ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer, en memallein hemenna veshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim bakkenisa uvaytzia. rabbi yehuda omer, kotel sheal gabbah tiddon mishshum mechitztza. amar rabbi yehuda, maase vaamma shel avel shehayu memallein mimmenna al pi zekenim beshabbat. amru lo, mippene shello haya vah kashshiur:
8.8: Gezuztera shehi lemala min hammayim, en memallein hemenna veshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim, ben milmala ben millematta. vechen shete gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo. asu laelyona velo asu lattachtona, shetehen asurot ad sheyyearevu:
8.9: Chatzer shehi fechuta mearba ammot, en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat, ella im ken asu lah uka machazeket satayim min hannekev ulematta, ben mibbachutz ben mibbifnim, ella shemmibbachutz tzarich likmor, mibbifnim en tzarich likmor:
8.10: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, biv shehu kamur arba ammot birshut harabbim, shofchin letocho mayim beshabbat. vachachamim omrim, afillu gag o chatzer mea amma, lo yishpoch al pi habbiv, aval shofech miggag legag, vehammayim yordin labbiv. hechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot:
8.11: Vechen shete deyotaot zo cheneged zo, miktzatan asu uka umiktzatan lo asu uka, et sheasu uka, muttarin, veet shello asu uka, asurin:

9.1: Kol gaggot hair, reshut achat, uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoah asara o namoch asara, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo. rabbi shimon omer, echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot, reshut echad lakkelim sheshshavtu letochan, velo lakkelim sheshshavtu vetoch habbayit:
9.2: Gag gadol samuch lekatan, haggadol muttar vehakkatan asur. chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna, gedola mutteret, uketanna asura, mippene shehi chefitchah shel gedola. chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim, hammachnis mittochah lirshut hayyachid, o mershut hayyachid letochah, chayyav, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mittochah lirshut harabbim, o mershut harabbim letochah, patur, mippene shehi kecharmelit:
9.3: Chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim mishshete ruchoteha, vechen bayit shennifratz mishshete ruchotav, vechen mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav, muttarin beoto shabbat vaasurin leatid lavo, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, im muttarin leoto shabbat, muttarin leatid lavo. veim asurin leatid lavo, asurin leoto shabbat:
9.4: Habbone aliyya al gabbe shene vattim, vechen gesharim hamefullashim, metaltelin tachtehen beshabbat, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim osrin. veod amar rabbi yehuda, mearvin lemavoy hamefullash. vachachamim osrin:

10.1: Hammotze tefillin, machnisan zug zug. rabban gamliel omer, shenayim shenayim. bamme devarim amurim, bishanot, aval bachadashot, patur. metzaan tzevatim o cherichot, machshich alehen umevian. uvassakkana, mechassan veholech lo:
10.2: Rabbi shimon omer, notnan lachavero, vachavero lachavero, ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona. vechen beno, notno lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu mea. rabbi yehuda omer, noten adam chavit lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu chutz lattechum. amru lo, lo tehallech zo yoter meragle vealeha:
10.3: Haya kore vassefer al haaskuppa, nitgalgel hassefer miyyado, gollo etzlo. haya kore verosh haggag venitgalgel hassefer miyyado, ad shello higgia laasara tefachim, gollo etzlo. mishshehiggia laasara tefachim, hofcho al hakketav. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu en mesullak min haaretz ella chimlo machat, gollo etzlo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu vaaretz atzmo gollo etzlo, sheen lecha davar mishshum shevut omed bifne chitve hakkodesh:
10.4: Ziz shellifne challon, notnin alav venotlin mimmennu veshabbat. omed adam birshut hayyachid umetaltel birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim umetaltel birshut hayyachid, uvilvad shello yotzi chutz mearba ammot:
10.5: Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyashtin birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyashtin birshut hayyachid. vechen lo yarok. rabbi yehuda omer, af mishshennitlash rukko befiv, lo yehallech arba ammot ad sheyarok:
10.6: Lo yaamod adam birshut hayachid veyishte virshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyishte virshut hayachid, ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo limkom shehu shote. vechen begat. kolet adam min hammazchela lematta measara tefachim. umin hatztzinnor, mikkol makom shote:
10.7: Bor birshut harabbim, vechulyato gevoha asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbav memallein hemennu veshabbat. ashpa virshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim, challon sheal gabbah shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat:
10.8: Ilan shehu mesech al haaretz, im en nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim, metaltelin tachtav. sharashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim, lo yeshev alehen. haddelet shebbammuktze vachadakim shebbappirtza umachatzalot, en noalin bahen, ella im ken gevohim min haaretz:
10.9: Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyiftach birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim veyiftach birshut hayyachid, ella im ken asa mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim, divre rabbi meir. amru lo, maase veshuk shel pattamin shehaya virushalayim, shehayu noalin umannichin et hammafteach bachallon sheal gabbe happetach. rabbi yose omer, shuk shel tzammarim haya:
10.10: Neger sheyyesh berosho gelustera, rabbi eliezer oser, verabbi yose mattir. amar rabbi eliezer, maase vakkeneset shebbitverya shehayu nohagin bo hetter, ad shebba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim veasru lahen. rabbi yose omer, issur nahagu vah, ba rabban gamliel vehazzekenim vehittiru lahen:
10.11: Neger hannigrar, noalim bo vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. vehammunnach, kan vachan asur. rabbi yehuda omer, hammunnach muttar bammikdash, vehannigrar bammedina:
10.12: Machazirin tzir hattachton bammikdash, aval lo vammedina. vehaelyon, kan vechan asur. rabbi yehuda omer, haelyon bammikdash, vehattachton bammedina:
10.13: Machazirin retiyya vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im battechilla, kan vechan asur. koshrin nima vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im battechilla, kan vechan asur. chotchin yabbelet bammikdash, aval lo vammedina. veim bichli, kan vechan asur:
10.14: Kohen shellaka veetzbao, korech aleha gemi vammikdash, aval lo vammedina. im lehotzi dam, kan vechan asur. bozkin melach al gabbe chevesh bishvil shello yachaliku, umemalleim mibbor haggola umibbor haggadol baggalgal beshabbat, umibbeer hakkar beyom tov:
10.15: Sheretz shennimtza vammikdash, kohen motzio vehemyano, shello leshahot et hattuma, divre rabbi yochanan ben beroka. rabbi yehuda omer, bitzvat shel etz, shello lerabbot et hattuma. mehechan motziin oto, min hahechol umin haulam umibben haulam velammizbeach, divre rabbi shimon ben nannas. rabbi akiva omer, mekom shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, mishsham motziin oto, ushear kol hammekomot kofin alav pesachter. rabbi shimon omer, mekom shehittiru lecha chachamim, mishshellecha natnu lecha, shello hittiru lecha ella mishshum shevut:
